Recorded claim:
D211683 removed registration for old text, vCard, and Mork file importers and removed dead text/vCard sources from moz.build. The prior address book test consolidation had moved coverage to AddrBookFileImporter, the path used by about:import. The MorkImport.cpp source still appeared in this intermediate build file, so distinguish removal of the import contract from removal of every Mork-related source. For new file import work, inspect the current live importer before reusing old contract IDs.

Provenance: 12e4f145ab7655355011e4c5c1521cf692a8b0cf09ac64627b2c693697e0cc73.
